title: Does Pinnacle provide home-based Occupational Therapy services for children with Autism?
metaTitle: Home-Based Occupational Therapy Services at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network offers home-based programs, home consultations, and online therapy sessions, ensuring your child benefits from therapy no matter the location.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that accessibility is vital for your child's continued progress. While our main service delivery mode is within our state-of-the-art centers, we definitely offer home-based programs, online therapy sessions, and home consultations. Our aim is to ensure that your child receives top-notch therapeutic services no matter the location.
